cues.en: Gitignore file, when we add this exclamation mark like we've done here, it means that the file or the pattern following this exclamation mark should be included in the git repository, even if it matches
cues.zh: .gitignore 中加入驚嘆號，代表驚嘆號後面的檔案或模式，應該納入 Git 儲存庫，即使它符合
